_doc: Measured text budgets per box variant (phase 5 width gate), read by tools/lint.py. px = sum of the half-width VWF advances (engine.half_widths) of the line; English is plain ASCII drawn with the half-width font (window font mode 3). status: measured (with the shot) or guess.

dialogue.what: script archive message body: the speaker box with a portrait (text from x=40); the engine pages every 2 lines, a blank line forces a new page, the page arrow sits at the right end of the 2nd line
dialogue.shot: map_290 with build.py --qa 34.10=...: 130 x I clipped at x=232 (pen 192); arrow at x=225-230 on line 2 (work/qa/torture3, work/qa/torture5)

name_tag.what: first line of a script archive message (speaker); the tag box grows with the byte count, about 6 px per byte from x=8
name_tag.shot: map_290, 'Baron Ashura (Male) Professor Kuruma' (36 bytes) fits, box ends at x=229 (work/qa/tag)

item_list.what: item menu list name field (8x8 font, 8-px VWF): from the name's x to the count graphic; both columns
item_list.shot: m1_item marker build: left name x=25, count x=96; right name x=136, count x=205 (work/qa/v8_m1_item); also the shop list (m2_shop, same window 0200AE80). Lint: every rec18 string (tools/fields.py TABLES)

battle_banner.what: battle top banner (printer call from 0x08086BFD, window font mode 2, ASCII drawn half-width): the used skill's name (skill_name copy), or an enemy name sprintf'd into a message (DE6A8 + D1FAC: '<enemy> appeared!'); bar interior x=2..235. Centred by byte count: x = 120 - 7 * bytes (11 bytes -> 43, 7 -> 71), clamped at 0, so English sits left of centre (cosmetic, phase 8)
battle_banner.status: measured (bar); composed messages (name + suffix) are checked through the top-level `composed` list
battle_banner.shot: game_over marker build f2580 ('DE6A8:aD1FAC:abcde' from x=0), f2910 ('DBDEC:abcde' from x=43), f3110 ('DBD68:a' from x=71) (work/qa/bf_goushouden_marker, JP: work/qa/bf_goushouden_en)

g_var.what: {g}: the item name (00.01 '{g}を手に入れた') or money amount (00.02 '{g}円') inserted at run time; counted at this width in a dialogue line
g_var.status: guess: item names are held to ~70 px by the item/equipment list budgets, amounts are a few digits
g_var.shot: none yet (phase 8: pick up an item / money)

name_var.what: {p} / {s}: the player-entered hero / heroine name, inserted at run time; counted at this width in a line
name_var.shot: name entry takes 7 chars (work/qa/namelen3: the 8th A confirms); kana draw at 12 px in a line ('|{p}|' with the default メイン = 36 px, work/qa/pvar), so 7 x 12. The JP keeps the same room (<= 9 other chars beside {p})

composed.what: '<enemy> appeared!': 0x080870E4 stpcpy(sp+0x28, enemy name) then stpcpy(end, r0D1FAC), no separator (the suffix carries its own leading space); stack buffer sp+0x28..sp+0x8C (frame sub sp,#0xA4 at 0x08087032; next local sp+0x8C) = 100 bytes; printed by 0x08086B38

'<item> stolen!': 0x0808C1BA item name (0x08014E10: table 0x7C55D8, stride 0x18) stpcpy'd to sp+4, then stpcpy(end, r0D2234), no separator; buffer sp+4..sp+0x24 (the next local, a 32-byte struct copy) = 32 bytes; printed by 0x08086B38. The gold form (0x0808C238: itoa then r0D2270 ' yen stolen!') needs <= 19 digits: not linted
